summary: Frontend-only test of the new /quiz feature. 80/81 assertions passed. All state-machine transitions (intro → 6 questions → result → retake), data-testids, progress bar, back button state preservation, bridge CTA to /pricing, hero-quiz-link and footer-quiz all working. Regression on 6 other routes returns 200. Found 1 real bug (nested <a> hydration warning in the result CTA) and 1 scoring-coherence quirk.

ui_bugs.issue: Hydration/DOM validation error: nested <a> inside <a>. `<Link href="/pricing">` (wouter) renders an <a>, and its child is another <a> element with `data-testid=quiz-cta-founding`. Same pattern for the 'Read the journal' Link (child is an <a>). Console errors: 'In HTML, <a> cannot be a descendant of <a>' and '<a> cannot contain a nested <a>'. Reproduces on every result render.

integration_issues.flow: Scoring — 'red fruit + light body + bone_dry + bright + young + under_25' returns Riesling (a white) instead of a light red / rosé
integration_issues.issue: AXIS_WEIGHTS.budget (5) dominates fruit (3). For this combo no red wine matches budget=under_25, so Riesling (perfect on all other axes + under_25) beats Rosé Provence (matches fruit + body + bright but priced 25_50) and Cru Beaujolais (grip=soft, priced 25_50). Reviewer explicitly flagged this combo as needing a light red/rosé. Two mitigations: (a) reduce budget weight to ~3, or (b) add a light-red under-$25 wine (e.g. entry-level Beaujolais-Villages or an Aussie Pinot under $25). Big-red and crisp-white combos scored correctly (Cabernet Sauvignon, Riesling).

action_items: Fix nested in Quiz.tsx result: replace `...` with `See a Founding-Member plan →` (wouter Link forwards props to the anchor it renders). Same fix for the 'Read the journal' Link below the retake button.
Tune scoring so red-fruit answers don't return a white wine. Either lower AXIS_WEIGHTS.budget from 5 → 3 (so fruit isn't overridden) OR add 1-2 light-red / rosé wines priced under_25 to the dataset.
critical_code_review_comments: Quiz.tsx: nested <a> inside wouter <Link> — real bug producing console errors on every result render.
quizData.ts: budget weight (5) is higher than fruit weight (3); this makes the fruit answer semantically overridable by price, which contradicts the spirit of a wine quiz. Consider re-balancing.
Quiz.tsx line 8 imports several types (Fruit, B, Sweetness, Grip, Age) that are unused — only Budget is used at runtime. Minor cleanup.
Result Retake+Journal row also nests <a> inside a Link (same pattern) — same fix required.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Quiz flow, testids, routes, and regressions all verified. Two open issues to retest after main agent fix: (1) confirm no nested-<a> hydration console errors on /quiz result view, (2) confirm red-fruit + light-body + under_25 combo returns a light red or rosé (not a white).
rca_of_the_issue: Nested <a>: wouter's <Link> renders its own <a> and the code additionally wraps content in an <a>. Fix by removing the inner <a> and passing testid/style to the Link itself. Scoring quirk: AXIS_WEIGHTS.budget=5 outweighs AXIS_WEIGHTS.fruit=3, so when no red wine matches the budget, a same-budget white with matching remaining axes wins.
